definitions.explanation: An elegant, refined quality that reflects good breeding, sophistication, and moral character. Often used to describe people with cultured manners or things with tasteful elegance.

examples.japanese: {品格|ひんかく}のある{人|ひと}
{彼女|かのじょ}の{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}いには{品格|ひんかく}がある。
examples.english: There is grace in her manners.

examples.japanese: {国家|こっか}の{品格|ひんかく}は、{国民|こくみん}の{行動|こうどう}によって{示|しめ}される。
examples.english: A nation's dignity is demonstrated by the conduct of its people.

notes:
NUANCE: {品格|ひんかく} suggests refined elegance with moral undertones. It implies both external grace and inner character. The book「{国家|こっか}の{品格|ひんかく}」(The Dignity of the Nation) made this term widely discussed in the 2000s.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品格|ひんかく}がある/ない (to have/lack dignity)
- {品格|ひんかく}のある{人|ひと} (a person of refinement)
- {品格|ひんかく}を{保|たも}つ (to maintain dignity)
- {品格|ひんかく}を{損|そこ}なう (to damage one's dignity)

RELATED WORDS:
- {品|ひん} (elegance, refinement)
- {気品|きひん} (elegance, grace)
- {風格|ふうかく} (dignity, character)
- {威厳|いげん} (dignity, majesty - more imposing)
